text:
Being passionate fans of sports like skiing, climbing, hiking and kayaking,
after a short deliberation we chose — believe it or not — Italy!

We have traveled a lot, especially with skis.
The Alps attract so much that one trip becomes the start of a tradition.

The Alps mean mountains inspire, service takes care,
we fully accompany you, and you simply enjoy.
With us, vacation is that very Vacation you dream about.

resorts.title: Best Ski Resorts in Italy
resorts.subtitle: We work at the most prestigious Alpine resorts

pianiDiBobbio.name: Piani di Bobbio
pianiDiBobbio.description: Special 25% discount! Perfect resort for those who want to ski near Milan. Modern lifts, 40+ km of trails for all levels, and traditional Italian atmosphere. Great choice for first-time Alpine experience.

madesimo.name: Madesimo
madesimo.description: Picturesque Valchiavenna valley with steep slopes and 60+ km of trails. Ideal for experienced skiers seeking a challenge. Elevation up to 2900 m guarantees excellent snow all season.

bivio.name: Bivio
bivio.description: Cozy Swiss village at Julier Pass at 1769 m elevation. Ideal for families: peaceful atmosphere, varied trails for all levels, and direct access to lifts right from the hotel. Great choice for those seeking comfortable skiing without the hustle of large resorts.
highlights: Ski school for children from 3 years

sanktMoritz.name: Sankt Moritz
sanktMoritz.description: Legendary Swiss resort - birthplace of winter tourism. 350+ km of trails at elevations up to 3300 m, luxury hotels and restaurants. For those who value prestige and elegance.

valmalenco.name: Valmalenco
valmalenco.description: Authentic Italian valley without tourist crowds. 40+ km of trails from 1200 to 2700 m, excellent freeride conditions. Ideal for those seeking to get a true Italian experience away from popular routes.

aprica.name: Aprica
aprica.description: Cozy family resort at 1180–2300 m elevation. 50+ km of trails perfect for beginners and intermediate skiers. Excellent infrastructure, children's schools, and peaceful atmosphere make it ideal for first-time alpine skiing experience.

livigno.name: Livigno
livigno.description: Farthest resort (200+ km from Milan), but one of Italy's highest-altitude resorts (1816–2900 m). 115 km of trails, duty-free zone, and affordable prices. Long skiing season thanks to elevation. Great choice for those not afraid of a long drive.

review3.name: Olga

We saw an ad for La Vacanza Bianca on Instagram and decided to write. In the end, it was a real, sporty, beautiful, unforgettable vacation! With Tatyana we selected the route and hotel. Dmitry met us in Como and was our guide for both days. Very caring, calm, professional. We just had to ski and enjoy!"

faq.question: How much does a bespoke tour to Italy, Switzerland or the Alps cost?
faq.answerHtml: It depends on the route, season and hotel tier. After a short call we send a clear quote—no hidden extras.

faq.question: What is included in the tour price?
faq.answerHtml: Typically the programme, guiding, hotels with breakfast and on-trip logistics. Flights and visas are discussed separately—we help you choose.

faq.question: Can I cancel or reschedule?
faq.answerHtml: Terms are fixed in the agreement upfront. We pick an option that matches your comfort with risk.

faq.question: Are these group or private tours?
faq.answerHtml: We focus on small groups and a private pace—no crowds or rigid mass-market schedules.

faq.question: Can we travel as a couple or with friends?
faq.answerHtml: Yes. The route and service adapt to your party—couples, families or a small group of friends.

faq.question: Do you help with flights and visas?
faq.answerHtml: We guide you on documents and convenient flights. Visa applications and ticket purchase stay with you, but we support with practical tips.

italyPage.metaDescription: Bespoke Italy tours 2026: Lake Como & Garda, the Dolomites & Northern Italy. Private itineraries, comfortable programmes and a trip tailored to you. See pricing and available dates.
italyPage.heroDescription: Bespoke routes across Northern Italy, the Alps and the lakes
italyPage.northHeading: Discover the real Italy with Vacanza Bianca
northParagraphs: Italy is a country people visit for its atmosphere, zest for life, and variety of experiences. It lets you blend cities and history, nature, gastronomy, and downtime at your own pace. That is why tours to Italy remain one of the most sought-after options—and we know how to plan a trip you will not just see, but truly live.

We design thoughtful bespoke tours across Italy—from classic itineraries to fully custom routes. This is not a cookie-cutter programme, but a coherent journey with smooth logistics, well-planned transfers, and attention to detail. It works whether it is your first time in the country or you want to explore Italy more deeply.

Planning a trip to Italy for 2026—or ready to book now with clear terms and none of the organisational hassle? We will match dates, hotels, and routing to your travel style. Choose a ready-made format or build a private tour: more intensive, relaxed, or balanced.
We help you early on see which routes make sense now and how to structure the trip—without overload, random stops, or unnecessary expense.
The cost of a tour in Italy depends on season, length, and comfort level. We explain budgets transparently and help you understand what different formats cost so you can choose with confidence.
If you want a well-organised holiday in Italy without chaotic planning—we are ready to take on the full planning and logistics.
Vacanza Bianca is about journeys to Italy that stay with you not as a checklist of places, but as a feeling.

faq.question: How much does a tour to Italy cost?
faq.answerHtml: It depends on the route, season and hotel level. Programmes start from 4600 EUR; we prepare the final quote after a consultation.

faq.question: What is included in the tour price?
faq.answerHtml:
The price typically includes:

  • hotel with pool and breakfast;
  • transfers along the route;
  • private guiding;
  • boat and kayak outings;
  • SPA time;
  • safety gear (life jackets, poles, helmets, gloves, etc.).

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Italy?
faq.answerHtml: Yes, you usually need a Schengen visa. We help with timelines and documents during preparation.

faq.question: When is the best time to visit Italy?
faq.answerHtml:
For lakes and city trips, May–October works best.

Ski programmes are best in winter and early spring.

faq.question: Are flights included?
faq.answerHtml:
No, flights are not included.

We can help you pick convenient flights for your route and dates.

faq.question: How much does a Switzerland tour cost?
faq.answerHtml: The price of a Switzerland tour is calculated individually and depends on season, length, route, hotel level and group size. For example, the Dolomites — St. Moritz route starts from 6900 €. The price of an Alps ski tour depends on the resort, trip length, hotel, transfers and support format. We confirm the exact price after a consultation.

faq.question: What is included in a Switzerland tour?
faq.answerHtml: The contents depend on the programme. A bespoke tour usually includes full trip organisation: hotel stays, transfers and complete support at every location.

faq.question: When is the best time to visit Switzerland?
faq.answerHtml: In winter Switzerland suits skiing, SPA and Alpine stays. In summer and early autumn it is ideal for hiking, panoramic routes, lakes and calm mountain travel. The best season depends on the format you prefer.

faq.question: Can Switzerland and Italy be combined in one tour?
faq.answerHtml: Yes. We can build a private Switzerland and Italy tour — for example combining the Dolomites, St. Moritz, Lake Como, Milan and other Northern Italy points in one trip. We plan the route so the journey feels logical and comfortable.

faq.question: Do you help with tickets and visas?
faq.answerHtml: Flights and consular fees are usually not included in the base tour price, but we help with flight recommendations, entry route, visa questions and document preparation.

guide.heading: Your guide to St. Moritz and the Alps
guide.text: Hi, I’m Dmitry, founder of Vacanza Bianca. I live in Italy and personally design and lead tours so the journey is not about “more places”, but about more pleasure and real emotions. We create trips around your rhythm: without rush, with thoughtful logistics, comfortable hotels and attention to detail. You get not a template tour, but a personal experience where every day is planned ahead and there is still room for freedom. Our goal is for you to rest, not solve organisational questions during the trip. If you like a beautiful, calm and meaningful journey through Italy and the Alps, I’ll be glad to create your personal holiday in one of the most beautiful regions in the world.

trentino.title: Slava
trentino.quote:
We had an amazing experience discovering Trentino with our guide Dmitry. In just a few days we kayaked on beautiful lakes and canyons and completed fantastic hikes and via ferratas.

One of the biggest advantages was that Dmitry picked us up by car and prepared all the gear for each activity in advance — we did not have to worry about rentals or organisation.

His knowledge of the area, infrastructure and Italian language saved us a lot of time and stress. We could focus on nature instead of logistics.

If you want to explore Trentino actively, comfortably and without organisational headaches — we warmly recommend this tour. Thank you, Dmitry, for an unforgettable adventure!

faq.question: How much does a St. Moritz tour cost?
faq.answerHtml: The price of a St. Moritz tour is calculated individually and depends on the season, duration, hotel level, route, transfers and guiding format. If you choose the combined “Dolomites – St. Moritz” route, prices start from 6900 €. The final offer is prepared after a consultation.

faq.question: Where is St. Moritz?
faq.answerHtml: St. Moritz is in the Swiss Alps, in the Upper Engadin region. The resort suits winter skiing, spa stays, summer walks, hiking and panoramic routes.

faq.question: When is the best time to visit St. Moritz?
faq.answerHtml: In winter guests choose St. Moritz for skiing, spa and Alpine rest. In summer and early autumn it works well for hiking, lakes, panoramic routes and a quieter mountain break.

faq.question: Can we combine St. Moritz with Italy?
faq.answerHtml: Yes. We can build a Switzerland + Italy route: St. Moritz, the Dolomites, Lake Como, Milan and the Bernina Express. Logistics, hotels, transfers and activities are planned in advance.

faq.question: Is this only a ski trip?
faq.answerHtml: No. St. Moritz can be part of a ski trip, a spa holiday, a summer hiking itinerary or a combined Switzerland and Northern Italy journey.

faq.question: What is included in the tour organisation?
faq.answerHtml: The exact package depends on the programme. We usually help with the route, hotels, transfers, activities, restaurants, spa and guiding. The final list of services is confirmed before booking.
